idea: Six bare zones of a 2020 SE Portland daylight-basement ADU (egress-window nook, under-stair pantry, kitchenette, fold-down bed wall, media wall, entry laundry closet) turn into six different built-ins in six summer light moments, climaxing on a persimmon-orange lacquer cabinet wall.
